title: Batch version executor
description: Run versioning for all affected libraries and create a single batch commit

base.description: Base git ref for affected detection

head.description: Head git ref for affected detection

scopeFiltering.description: Commit scope filtering used when attributing commits to a project. Defaults to the version target's declaration.

maxCommitFallback.description: Upper bound on the commit window the flow analyzes for bumps and changelogs.

releaseAs.description: Force this bump on the libraries named by --libraries, calculated from each one's published version. For a release whose change is in the package artifact rather than its code, such as a readme; the changelog lists every commit since the last release.

libraries.description: Project names to version instead of the affected set. Required with --releaseAs, and only meaningful with it.
